entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Luis Espert is an Argentine economist and politician. He is member of the political coalition La Libertad Avanza. He was elected National Deputy for the Province of Buenos Aires in the 2021 Argentine legislative election. He was the founder and leader of the Avanza Libertad coalition, briefly joined Juntos por el Cambio in 2023, and became a member of La Libertad Avanza the following year.
